summary: The prospective ELIGIBLE/MATCHED reader correction, canonical full T6 freshness query reach, earlier invalid reconstruction denial, owner locking, duplicate serialization, rollback, revocation, finite expiry and own namespace cleanup are supported by inspected code and committed PostgreSQL evidence. Required legacy T6/T7 owner coverage fails, and the bound hosted full DB regression has no completed PASS. The exact packet DoD is unsatisfied.

findings.title: Required legacy owner trajectory cannot consume its genuine COMMIT_READY outputs
findings.description: The legacy preparation owners persist S37.ref_s34_id=N while S35.ref_s34_id=F. prepare_authorization_basis requires equality of those two IDs whenever full_execution_members is absent and raises policy, demand, and calendar authorization bounds must exist. The genuine canonical legacy chain therefore reaches COMMIT_READY but fails T6 before the required START/PAUSE/RESUME/CONTINUE trajectory. This is independently confirmed by the raw traceback and JUnit: source_owner_trajectories_dc has 1 failure/1 pass and source_suite_dc has 1 failure/105 passes, both with test_owner_trajectories[legacy] failing. This incompatibility is in unchanged consumer behavior, but the packet explicitly requires the positive legacy trajectory and passing full own suite; a blocked result does not satisfy that oracle.
findings.required_change: Resolve the declared legacy oracle and runtime write boundary through coordinator-approved scope/packet work or a separately authorized compatibility task, then run all exact required checks on a new immutable tested revision and obtain fresh reviews. Do not forge a certificate, seed target outputs, alter immutable outputs, weaken bindings, or relabel this failed trajectory PASS.

findings.title: Mandatory unchanged hosted full DB regression lacks bound PASS evidence
findings.description: At the reviewed implementation/result revision, hosted-status.json and raw run 37081179328 record the unchanged PostgreSQL workflow at tested_commit 15a7167e44b8044c94688cf7e367e2d02a962e31 as in_progress with an empty conclusion. The quality workflow success is separate. No completed hosted uv run pytest tests/db PASS with positive execution counts is present at this reviewed SHA. That mandatory check covers the corrected legacy fixtures and transaction-interface/interleaving regressions and cannot be substituted by the own suite.
findings.required_change: Complete and inspect the unchanged hosted full DB workflow, preserve revision-bound completed raw output and positive execution evidence in pre-review task evidence/result on a new implementation/result revision, address any failures, and obtain fresh SHA-bound reviews. A later review-only append cannot supply missing pre-review task evidence.
